segments.context: Verve Coffee Roasters · United StatesVancouver Swiss Water DecafVancouver is a plausible first water-process decaf for a US buyer who wants Verve's medium, almond-and-chocolate brief and published filter starts. The Colombia/Uganda blend and 12 oz format are clear on the current page. Espresso owners can try it but must make a separate recipe; an owner report cannot stand in for a roaster espresso specification or a Coffeedant taste test.Updated 2026-11-09 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 9, 2026
